earnings.title: MSCI Reports Financial Results for
highlights: Diluted EPS of $4.86, up 14.4%; Adjusted EPS of $5.11, up 14.3%
Operating revenues of $892.0 million, up 12.4%; Organic operating revenue growth of 12.3%
Recurring subscription revenues up 7.7%; Asset-based fees up 24.9%
Operating margin of 56.3%; Adjusted EBITDA margin of 62.2%
In third quarter 2026 and through October 19, 2026, a total of $627.2 million or 1,116,460 shares were repurchased at an average repurchase price of $561.81

quotes.text: In the third quarter MSCI delivered strong financial and operating metrics, including our best-ever recurring net-new sales in Analytics and Private Capital Solutions, our best-ever Q3 recurring net-new sales in Index, and another record quarter for asset-based fees.
